caption:
Before you paste text into an AI chat, swap private details for placeholders. 🔒

Try: "Rewrite this email. I replaced real details with [NAME] and [AMOUNT]."

Then fill the real details back in yourself. 📌 Save this habit.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.text: Think before you paste work emails into AI.

scenes.title: Find the private details
scenes.say: First, spot the private details. Names, phone numbers, addresses, account info. Anything you would not post publicly.

scenes.title: AI chat
scenes.user: Rewrite this email politely. [NAME] owes us [AMOUNT] by [DATE].
scenes.reply:
Hi [NAME],
A friendly reminder that
[AMOUNT] is due by [DATE].
Thank you!
scenes.say: Second, replace them with placeholders in square brackets. The AI still writes a great draft.

scenes.title: Fill in the real details yourself
scenes.body: Do it in your own email, not in the chat.
scenes.say: Third, type the real details back in yourself, in your own email, not in the chat.

scenes.label: private details for placeholders
scenes.say: Placeholders keep private info out of the chat. Easy habit, real protection.
